[[File:Welding_Beetle.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Welding Beetle droid on Annoo]]
A '''Welding Beetle''' was a model of hovering [[droid]]. It had two long, pointed arms and could shoot a stream of oil as well as weld. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] encountered a Welding Beetle while waiting in a queue to be registered upon arrival on [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]]. Artoo angrily objected to the droid cutting into line in front of them, prompting the droid to give Threepio a face full of oil. The droid could also be found in [[Sise Fromm's stronghold]].
